mapper.select: select mn.*, pp.P_Name as pName, cc.Con_Name as conName, cc.Con_Code as conCode, cp.Pay_Code as payCode from Con_Pay_Multi_Project mn left join Pre_Project pp on mn.p_Id = pp.P_ID left join Con_Contract cc on mn.Con_Id = cc.Con_Id left join Con_Pay cp on mn.Pay_Id = cp.Pay_Id where mn.cpm_Id = #{id}
